Our independent implementation regenerates all 12480 proper states, builds 45240 edges, checks two 6240 components and runs BFS from every state; checks parity/dihedral action on all states, not merely a representative. Source verify.cpp control flow and full 4^11 scan were inspected; this is an exhaustive finite proof, unlike sampled simulations.

value.rationale: The Grötzsch graph is the canonical smallest triangle-free 4-chromatic graph; a complete, nontrivial 12480-state recolouring chamber classification, symmetry obstruction and sharp diameter is a reusable finite benchmark in reconfiguration theory.

final_claim: For the standard Mycielskian of C5, the 4-colouring single-vertex recolouring graph has 12480 labelled states and 45240 edges, exactly two 6240-state components of diameter 17 with degree counts (240,1320,1920,2160,600) at degrees 5..9 per component; odd palette permutations and reflections swap components, even permutations and rotations preserve; its mixing threshold is 5.
